gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi reads wide open, its small letters holding big counters and generous curves. Goldman is the one to lean on for bold, commanding heads, while Anek Gurmukhi handles the sentences underneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam sits low and tidy, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase and curves that never quite close. And Goldman's wide, bold letters above it make a longer read feel loose and easy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-odia: Commanding, wide-set Goldman up top. Anek Odia follows with unlatched rounds and capitals only just above the lowercase, so paragraphs of it move along smoothly without any friction.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anuphan: Wide, bold Goldman letters stand over Anuphan, whose big round bowls and open curves keep every word clear. Paragraphs flow easily.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-arimo: Arimo reads tall and spacious, its rounded letters leaving clear gaps at every terminal, so the lines stay easy to follow. Goldman earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Commanding Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like forms wide for headings, and Carrois Gothic SC quietly handles the text with open curve endings and a flat capital-to-lowercase height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-duru-sans: Modern, wide-mouthed small letters dominate Duru Sans while its ascenders barely show above them. Goldman, bold and wide-set, takes the heading; text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fresca: Neon tubing, then ordinary ink. Goldman bends bold, wide letters with a big lowercase, while Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside and its short ascenders over big bowls, so the page moves comfortably from one to the other.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans holds a steady stroke from stem to curve, with a lowercase e pried open wide. Goldman's low horizontal bars are lighter than its uprights. Long paragraphs read cleanly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Goldman opens with bold, wide-set letters. Its strength is commanding headings, while Hedvig Letters Sans does its best work in the text, with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals.
